//! Writes the genuine pre-change schema 12 fixtures the ordinary-quiet migration is tested
//! against. Run only from an isolated copy of the tree **before** the quiet extension exists;
//! the snapshots it writes are what that build actually produced, not a struct relabelled old.
//!
//! Two worlds, both from the default config and its own seed, because the migration has to be
//! shown byte-exact for **both** the default no-care trajectory and a default care one:
//!
//! Both resume the same frozen mature opening the quiet diagnosis used (seed 1 of the
//! prescribed cohort), because a freshly created world has not reproduced yet and the
//! migration has to be shown across worlds that carry real paid births.
//!
//! * `quiet-v12-plain-*`: no care at all, a plain autonomous world.
//! * `quiet-v12-care-*`: the quiet diagnosis's own recipe — one Standard Feed at elapsed 600,
//!   Front (32, 48) — so a schema 12 world carrying real care ledgers is covered too.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use cubarium_core::care::{CareCommand, CareKind, CareTarget};
use cubarium_core::{CareOutcome, SCHEMA_VERSION, World, decode_snapshot, encode_snapshot};

const BUILD: &str = "pre-quiet-fixture";

fn write(dir: &PathBuf, name: &str, world: &World) {
    let bytes = encode_snapshot(&world.state, BUILD);
    std::fs::write(dir.join(name), &bytes).expect("write the fixture");
    println!(
        "  wrote {name}: schema {SCHEMA_VERSION}, tick {}, {} bytes, pop {}, births {}, hash {}",
        world.tick(),
        bytes.len(),
        world.population(),
        world.state.births_total,
        cubarium_core::snapshot::state_hash(&world.state)
    );
}

fn step_to(world: &mut World, tick: u64) {
    while world.tick() < tick {
        world.step();
        world.drain_events();
    }
}

fn opening(path: &str) -> World {
    let bytes = std::fs::read(path).expect("the prescribed opening");
    let (meta, state) = decode_snapshot(&bytes).expect("it decodes");
    println!("  opening: schema {} tick {} pop {}", meta.schema, state.tick, state.organisms.len());
    assert!(state.care == Default::default() && state.hunters == Default::default());
    World::from_state(state).expect("a valid world")
}

fn main() {
    let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
    let dir = PathBuf::from(args.next().expect("an output directory"));
    let source = args.next().expect("a prescribed opening snapshot");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).expect("the output directory");
    assert_eq!(SCHEMA_VERSION, 12, "this generator writes the pre-change schema");

    // ---- a plain autonomous world that has actually reproduced
    println!("plain world:");
    let mut world = opening(&source);
    step_to(&mut world, 144_000 + 3000);
    assert!(world.state.births_total > 0, "the fixture needs real paid births");
    write(&dir, "quiet-v12-plain-3000.cubw", &world);
    step_to(&mut world, 144_000 + 3600);
    write(&dir, "quiet-v12-plain-3000-plus600.cubw", &world);

    // ---- the same world with the quiet diagnosis's single Standard Feed
    println!("care world:");
    let mut world = opening(&source);
    step_to(&mut world, 144_000 + 600);
    let tick = world.tick();
    let receipt = world.apply_care(&CareCommand::standard(
        1,
        tick,
        CareKind::Feed,
        CareTarget { face: 0, u: 32.0, v: 48.0 },
    ));
    println!("  feed at tick {tick}: {:?}", receipt.outcome);
    assert!(!matches!(receipt.outcome, CareOutcome::Rejected(_)), "the fixture needs this feed");
    step_to(&mut world, 144_000 + 3000);
    assert!(world.state.care.admitted_seq == 1 && world.state.care.feed_material_in > 0.0);
    assert!(world.state.births_total > 0, "the care fixture needs real paid births too");
    write(&dir, "quiet-v12-care-3000.cubw", &world);
    step_to(&mut world, 144_000 + 3600);
    write(&dir, "quiet-v12-care-3000-plus600.cubw", &world);
}
